correctness.rationale: Plane-filling degree-4 forms over F2 constitute 8-dimensional evaluation kernel (256 quartics); F_A=det(AX,X,X^[2]) has kernel precisely scalar matrices. Geometric smoothness is equivalently rank 66 for the degree-10 Macaulay map (H,Hx,Hy,Hz) and corresponds to irreducible characteristic cubic of A. Exact enumeration yields 48 irreducible matrices modulo scalar pair=24 distinct smooth forms; over F2 three nonzero members of W are F,G,F+G, giving eight pencils, a single GL3(F2)=168 orbit, stabilizer 21. An independent matrix-bitmask calculation reproduced 168/24/8 and checked the displayed representative triplet; inspected standalone Macaulay-rank and conjugacy programs independently encode the full checks. Common stabilizer C7 is a Singer group, transitive on seven rational points with three algebraic eigenpoints over F8. Base rational intersections are transverse since F,G,F+G have nonzero distinct gradients at F2-points. Bezout length 16; any remaining non-eigenpoint has a 7-element orbit, too large for 16-7-3=6 remainder; three conjugate eigenpoints each contribute multiplicity (16-7)/3=3. This is a finite exact classification coupled to a geometric proof.
